content_sections.heading: HBCH&RC Project Research Scientist-II Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.information: Walk-in interview; online interview by email request for outstation candidates

content_sections.heading: About HBCH&RC
content_sections.text: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre is a cancer hospital and research centre under the Tata Memorial Centre name on the notice's letterhead. It is located in the Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital Campus at Umanagar, Muzaffarpur, Bihar. This vacancy is under the project "Expanding Antimicrobial Resistance Research and Surveillance Activities in Secondary Level Hospitals" (Project A/c No. 5743), funded by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR).

content_sections.heading: HBCH&RC Project Research Scientist-II Vacancy Details 2026
HBCH&RC Project Research Scientist-II Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: 45 years as on the date of interview. Essential qualification and experience, as printed in the notice: Postgraduate degree in Microbiology, including integrated PG degrees, with three years post-qualification experience is desirable OR Ph.D. in Microbiology Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility wording for this post.

rows.event: Last date for email request for online interview

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through an interview. Candidates attending in person appear at the Muzaffarpur venue, while outstation candidates may be interviewed online. Only shortlisted candidates who fulfil the norms will be contacted for the online interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The post is on contract under a project. The appointment is initially for six months or till the continuation of the project, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HBCH&RC Project Research Scientist-II Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: For the walk-in interview: Go to the venue on 11 November 2026. The notice prints the timing as between 9.00 am to 10.00 am. Report to Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital Campus, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur (Bihar) - 842004. Carry the documents listed below. For outstation candidates seeking an online interview: Combine your resume and supporting documents into a single PDF file. Mention the post you are applying for in the subject line. Email the PDF to [email protected] before the deadline. Documents to carry for the interview: Bio-data Recent passport size photograph Original PAN Card and Aadhar Card Original experience certificates Original education certificates One set of self-attested copies of all certificates

faq.question: Q1. Who can I contact with a question about this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contact the HRD Department, HBCH&RC, Muzaffarpur, at [email protected] and/or on phone number 9472377509.

faq.question: Q2. Is a Ph.D. a separate route to eligibility?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice lists a Ph.D. in Microbiology as an "OR" option to the postgraduate degree in Microbiology.

faq.question: Q3. Are integrated PG degrees accepted?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice says the postgraduate degree in Microbiology includes integrated PG degrees.

faq.question: Q4. On which date is the age limit counted?
faq.answer: Age is counted on the date of interview, so walk-in candidates are measured on 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Which project is this post under?
faq.answer: It is under an ICMR-funded project on antimicrobial resistance research and surveillance in secondary level hospitals, Project A/c No. 5743.

faq.question: Q6. Does an email request guarantee an online interview?
faq.answer: No. Only shortlisted candidates who fulfil the norms will be contacted for the online interview.

faq.question: Q7. In what format should outstation candidates send their documents?
faq.answer: The resume and supporting documents must be sent together in a single PDF file.

faq.question: Q8. How many sets of certificate copies are needed at the walk-in?
faq.answer: Candidates need one set of self-attested copies of all certificates, along with the originals.
